description: Get the account's custody status. All tiers are custodial (this server holds the rotation key); the tier records an escrow provider on record and whether the user has exported their own copy of the key.

main.description: Returns recovery tier, checklist of security features, and upgrade suggestions.

recoveryTier.description: Recovery tier (1 = custodial, 2 = escrow provider recorded, 3 = key exported). All tiers are custodial.

tierName.description: Every tier is custodial: this server holds the rotation key. escrow-recorded: an escrow provider is on record (the share stays here). key-exported: the user also holds a copy of the rotation key.

upgradePath.description: Suggestion for next security upgrade, or null if at maximum tier.

pdsHoldsRotationKey.description: True when this server can rebuild the account's rotation key on its own.

custodyMode.description: Who holds the account's PLC rotation key (ADR-003). Absent or null when neither this server nor the user holds one here (external accounts).

deviceSigning.description: True when the account's device signs its repository (#240): this server cannot write to it.

deviceSigningKey.description: The device key PLC named when device signing was turned on; null when off.

securityChecklist.description: Per-feature boolean flags describing which security upgrades the user has completed.

vaultShares.description: Whether vault shares exist for this user.

escrowRegistered.description: Whether any share is held by an escrow provider.

keyExported.description: Whether recovery key has been exported (tier >= 3).
